subject: Request: demo delay — ask for trial extension & runway credits (SignalVista)
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex@signalvista.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot blocked: SSO + webhook integration failing — request extension and credits

Hi Marissa,

Sorry to pull you in here — we've run into a blocking issue on our side while wiring SignalVista's SSO and webhook flow into Redwood's sandbox. Our engineers hit an intermittent 401 from the sandbox SSO endpoint and webhooks are dropping for some requests; it's reproducible when we attempt larger payloads from our staging connector.

We were supposed to demo to our product committee next week, but engineering can't finalize the demo until the SSO token refresh behavior is resolved and we get stable webhook deliveries. That puts our pilot timeline at risk.

As a result, could Redwood consider: 1) a two-week extension of our pilot window, and 2) a 30k token sandbox credit to cover additional integration attempts and testing? We attached the integration-log.txt and a small usage export so you can see the failure patterns.

We really want to show this internally — momentum is high on our side — but we need runway to lock the connectors. Happy to hop on a call with engineering if that helps.

Thanks,
Alex Torres
CTO, SignalVista
alex@signalvista.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: integration-log.txt, doc-usage-report.csv
